programme.title: Time Story
programme.desc: Sethuraman, a scientist, invents a time-travelling gadget that his evil twin Athreya wants to get hold of. Soon, a bitter battle arises between Sethuraman's son and Athreya.

programme.title: Dil Dhadakne Do
programme.desc: Kamal and Neelam book a cruise for their 30th anniversary. Behind their loving public image lies the truth of their distant relationships with each other and their children.

programme.title: Welcome 2 Karachi
programme.desc: Amid high political tensions, two Indian men accidentally arrive in Pakistan without their passports and are kidnapped by the Taliban. Hilarious chaos ensues as they try to make their way back home.

programme.title: Khuda Haafiz: 2 - Agni Pariksha
programme.desc: After the death of his friend's brother, Sameer and Nargis adopt his daughter Nandini. However, trouble ensues when she gets kidnapped.

programme.title: Bangarraju
programme.desc: A deceased couple returns to Earth to help their grandson, who lost his way in life after familial and personal problems start to haunt him.

programme.title: Makkhi
programme.desc: After reincarnating as a fly, a murderer decides to take revenge on his rival, who killed him, and teams up with a woman to destroy the killer's life.

programme.title: Spyder
programme.desc: Shiva, an intelligence officer, develops a phone software that helps him track those in need of help. He sets out to save the people of Hyderabad when he realises that a serial killer is on the loose.

programme.title: Koyla
programme.desc: Silenced by a piece of smouldering coal in childhood, Shankar endures a life of slavery until love compels him to seek his voice, freedom, and long-overdue revenge.

programme.title: Ramaiya Vastavaiya
programme.desc: A man is challenged to work in a field and produce a huge harvest by the end of the season in order to marry the love of his life.

programme.title: Bengal Tiger
programme.desc: Akash, a simple man, falls in love with politician Gajapathi's daughter, Meera. However, on learning the identity of Akash's father, Gajapathi suspects that he wants revenge for a past transgression.

programme.title: Bengal Tiger
programme.desc: Akash, a simple man, falls in love with politician Gajapathi's daughter, Meera. However, on learning the identity of Akash's father, Gajapathi suspects that he wants revenge for a past transgression.

programme.title: Rock On 2
programme.desc: The music band members, once separated due to the conflict, reunite and organise a rock concert, but the local authorities oppose them.

programme.title: Hamari Adhuri Kahani
programme.desc: Half a decade after her husband went missing, Vasudha, a single mother, falls for Aarav, a hotelier. However, her missing husband, Hari, returns, thereby creating a rift between the two lovers.

programme.title: Rocket Gang
programme.desc: A group of friends visits a new resort, but their excitement is short-lived when they experience supernatural activities and are confronted by the ghosts of some young children.

programme.title: Tholi Prema
programme.desc: Fate offers Aditya and Varsha the opportunity to rekindle their youthful romance years after personality differences compelled them to go their separate ways.

programme.title: Annapoorani: The Goddess of Food
programme.desc: Annapoorani, a girl born into an orthodox Hindu family, aspires to become a top chef. However, she faces obstacles that include prejudice and conventional beliefs.

programme.title: Haq
programme.desc: Shazia Bano turns to the court for justice when her husband, Abbas, abandons her and their young children after marrying another woman.

programme.title: Sky Force
programme.desc: During the 1965 Indo-Pak conflict, India endures a catastrophic unexpected assault. Wing Commander Ahuja directs a counterattack, but Squadron Leader Vijaya disappears following a brave solo confrontation with a more powerful enemy aircraft. Ahuja dedicates 23 years to uncovering the truth, revealing a conspiracy, and finally achieving posthumous honor for Vijaya's courage and selflessness.

programme.title: Judaai
programme.desc: Shashikant and Gauri get married in honour of his late father's will. But, marital problems soon arise when Gauri suspects him of having an affair, leading to a chain of misunderstandings.

programme.title: Ravanasura
programme.desc: Ravindra, an inept junior lawyer at a law firm, agrees to help a business magnate clear her father's name of murder. However, when bodies start piling up, Ravindra begins to show his true colours.

programme.desc: Jatt Ambarsariya, a secret agent, embarks on a mission to save the Home Minister of Punjab from a drug mafia's vicious plans. During his mission, he wins the heart of three pretty ladies.

programme.title: State of Siege: Temple Attack
programme.desc: Armed with state-of-the-art equipment and a brilliant plan, National Security Guard commandos risk their lives to save innocent people caught in a terrorist attack on a temple in Gujarat.

programme.desc: Identical triplets get separated at a young age and follow different paths in life. Ill-treated as a child due to his stammering, the eldest seeks revenge on his brothers when they reunite as adults.

programme.title: Sanam Teri Kasam
programme.desc: A librarian, cast out by her family, asks her neighbour to help her find a suitable husband. However, their growing feelings for each other complicate the situation.

programme.title: Khiladi

programme.title: Game Changer

programme.title: Genius
programme.desc: An intelligent orphan joins RAW, an intelligence agency of India. However, during a mission, chaos ensues and all of his comrades are killed. Soon, he decides to seek revenge and comes up with a master plan in order to live in peace with the one he loves.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: The Zoo
programme.desc: Located just 10 miles from New York's Times Square, the Bronx Zoo is a recognised world leader in animal care and species conservation. It houses more than 6,000 animals and has a staff of 500-plus people dedicated to their care and well-being. Never before have camera crews been granted full access to the 265-acre campus, until production of the docuseries `The Zoo'. The results are stories focusing on dozens of animals and experiences at the facility, and its critical mission to conserve wildlife around the world. Episodes also highlight various employees and how their expertise and skills help provide top-quality care for the animals.

programme.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins
programme.desc: Carrying on late wildlife conservationist Steve Irwin's mission to bring people closer to animals is now the mission of his family. Terri, Bindi and Robert Irwin return to Animal Planet, giving viewers access to their wildlife adventures around the world and the amazing animals that continue to inspire their conservation efforts. The series features the family caring for more than 1,200 animals at the Australia Zoo; overseeing a world-class wildlife hospital, the largest of its kind in the world; and conducting high-level global expeditions.

programme.title: You Guys Are Couple Goals
programme.desc: Then - You see a hint of jealousy in Riya and Varun's relationship when they were still together. Now - Riya and Varun are "trying" to date other people(while they live together) with hilarious consequences.

programme.title: Mera Spondylitis Phoot Gaya!
programme.desc: An unfortunate accident leads to Riya and Varun realizing the small ways in which their relationship has changed since they were together.

programme.title: Bhen-dad!
programme.desc: A surprise visit from Riya's dad sends Riya, Varun, and Devika in disarray as they have to scramble to make sure he doesn't find out Riya and Varun are not a couple anymore.

programme.title: Mamla Gehra Hai
programme.desc: Riya and Varun are forced to make tough decisions about their future together in the house. To add to their woes, a burglary at the house leaves them deprived of a special possession.

programme.title: Humanize the Ex
programme.desc: To celebrate their stay at the house, the exes - Riya and Varun - decide to have a bonfire party on their lawn. There, they reminisce about their relationship so far.

programme.title: Naye Armaan
programme.desc: Varun turns 30, and Ria is introduced to Anisha. Back in the day, Varun and Ria finally move into a house together.

programme.title: Humesha
programme.desc: Ria decides to go home and tell her parents the truth about Varun and Ria's breakup. Back in the day, Varun and Ria's parents come over as the families meet and make plans for their future.

programme.title: Khwaab
programme.desc: Ria finally admits to having feelings for Varun. Back in the day, we see trouble in Varun and Ria's relationship for the first time.

programme.title: Tanha
programme.desc: Ria starts to look for new houses. Back in the day, Ria and Varun are still dealing with their broken trust, and everything changes.

programme.title: Darmaan
programme.desc: Varun and Ria break up.

programme.title: Hum
programme.desc: Varun and Ria try and make their relationship work.

programme.title: Feels Like Responsibility
programme.desc: As Avi and Lakshay prepare for their "first second house party", Avi's dad decides to drop in for a surprise visit. Meanwhile, Sameer tries to think of different ways to get his unwanted roommate Gandhi to shift to the living room instead. Will their first second party go as planned?

programme.title: Feels Like Give and Take
programme.desc: After weeks of witnessing the boys make a mess of Bancchod Niwas, Sameer tells them to clean up their act. Lakshay's solution is? Get a housekeeper. Meanwhile, Avi, still reeling from his breakup with Mahima, decides to make a "grand gesture", which also inspires Lakshay to get another quirky roommate.

programme.title: Feels Like Summer
programme.desc: As the Delhi heat rises in full force, tempers rise with it. Sameer tries to push himself to perform his poetry for an audience that isn't Lloyd, while Avi tries to drown his sorrows by pretending like he's completely fine. Tensions implode and so do Gandhi's... special parts.

programme.title: Feels Like Finding Yourself
programme.desc: Avi has the greatest plan (his words) to move on and spend time with himself - an Imtiaz Ali-themed tour of Delhi. What could go wrong? Meanwhile, Gandhi's first day of cricket practice doesn't quite go as planned, and Lakshay meets an unexpected acquaintance.

programme.title: Feels Like Family
programme.desc: The boys are at Lakshay's family home for his sister's wedding. As Avi and Gandhi gear up to get lucky, Sameer has a significant revelation. Lakshay, meanwhile, feels out of the loop with his own family, as he feels replaced by his nemesis John. The wedding weekend rages with the promise of chaos and drama.

programme.title: Feels Like Choices
programme.desc: The exam results of last semester are out and Avi's is less than perfect. Afraid to let his dad find out in case he is called back home, Avi cooks up a drastic plan with the help of Sameer and Gandhi. Meanwhile, Lakshay hosts a Fresher's party, where he comes to point of no return. Will the boys make the right choices?

programme.title: Wrath of Man
programme.desc: Mysterious and wild-eyed, a new security guard for a cash truck surprises his co-workers when he unleashes precision skills during a heist. The crew is left wondering who he is and where he came from. Soon, the marksman's ultimate motive becomes clear as he takes dramatic and irrevocable steps to settle a score.

programme.title: The Ambush
programme.desc: When three Emirati soldiers are ambushed in hostile territory, their commander leads a daring mission to rescue them.

programme.title: Feels Like Rock Bottom
programme.desc: A single-take episode right after the events of the party where Avi finds out about Lakshay and Mahima, a fight breaks out between the boys as they deal with their own fears and the problems they have with each other. Will this be the end of their friendship?

programme.title: Feels Like Acceptance
programme.desc: Tensions in the house are at an all-time high. In the middle of this, Vicky Paaji comes home unannounced and starts to stay with the boys. The boys must now team up to kick Vicky Paaji out.

programme.title: Feels Like Hope
programme.desc: As the college fest approaches, Avi and Lakshay are teamed up together which leads to worse consequences for the two of them. Gandhi goes on a journey to find a new passion by participating in the fest, and Sameer pushes himself to face his fear of performing at the fest.

programme.desc: In this 13-part documentary series, hosts Scott Wilson and Ellis Emmett descend beneath the surface to explore the three-quarters of the planet that is covered in water. With each dive into the unknown, they encounter creatures and sights that most people will never get to experience.
